requirements.title: Patient Portal
requirements.description: A patient portal with features for telehealth consultations, prescription management, billing, and insurance claims
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to access a patient portal to manage my healthcare services

test_steps.action: Log in to the patient portal

requirements.title: Telehealth Consultations
requirements.description: Telehealth consultations with video conferencing tools, patient information, and consultation notes
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to participate in telehealth consultations
ambiguities: Handling of technical issues during consultation

requirements.title: Prescription Management
requirements.description: Prescription management with prescription lists, patient information, and refill requests
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want to manage prescriptions and refills

requirements.title: Billing and Insurance Claims
requirements.description: Billing and insurance claims with payment form, payment plan setup wizard, and claim submission
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to pay my bills and submit insurance claims
acceptance_criteria: Payment form accepts various payment methods

requirements.title: Security and Data Modeling
requirements.description: Security measures with MFA, biometric login, and data modeling for patient profiles and prescriptions
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want to ensure security and data modeling for the patient portal
acceptance_criteria: Data models for patient profiles and prescriptions

requirements.title: Insurance Claim & Adjudication Page
requirements.description: Page for managing insurance claims and adjudication, including claim forms, patient information, and adjudication status with filtering by claim status
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want an insurance claim page, so that I can manage claims and adjudication efficiently

requirements.title: Patient Billing & Payment Flow Page
requirements.description: Page for managing patient billing and payment flow, including invoices, payment methods, and payment history with filtering by payment status
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want a patient billing page, so that I can manage billing and payments efficiently

requirements.title: Appointment Calendar Page
requirements.description: Displays appointment availability with query results returning within 800ms for a 30-day window
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to see appointment availability quickly, so I can schedule appointments efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Query results return within 800ms for a 30-day window

test_steps.action: Navigate to the appointment calendar page and query availability for a 30-day window
test_steps.expected_result: The results are displayed within the specified time
test_steps.test_data: Valid user credentials and a broadband connection

test_scenarios: Querying appointment availability for a 30-day window
assumptions: User has the necessary permissions to access the appointment calendar

requirements.title: Patient Dashboard Home Screen
requirements.description: Displays a personalized greeting, current date, upcoming appointments in a horizontal card carousel, left sidebar navigation, notification bell icon, and quick action tiles in a 2x2 grid
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to see my personalized dashboard, so that I can view my appointments and quickly access common actions
acceptance_criteria: Notification bell icon with unread count badge

test_steps.action: Navigate to Patient Dashboard Home Screen
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays with personalized greeting and upcoming appointments

requirements.title: Appointment Booking Integration
requirements.description: Calendar displays available slots, and booking confirmation modal shows provider details and visit type
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to book an appointment, so that I can schedule a visit with my provider
acceptance_criteria: Booking confirmation modal displays provider details

test_steps.action: Select a date on the calendar

requirements.title: Patient Registration Form
requirements.description: Form with fields for First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Email, Phone, and Create Password
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to create an account, so that I can access the patient portal

test_steps.expected_result: Form displays with all required fields

assumptions: Patient has valid email and phone number

requirements.title: Book Appointment Screen
requirements.description: Screen with fields for selecting provider, specialty, date, and time
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to book an appointment, so that I can schedule a visit with a provider

test_steps.expected_result: Screen displays with available appointment slots

assumptions: Patient has valid insurance and profile information

requirements.title: Pre-Visit Forms
requirements.description: Forms with fields for reviewing and signing consent forms electronically
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to review and sign consent forms, so that I can provide informed consent for my visit

test_steps.expected_result: Forms display with all required fields

requirements.title: Prescriptions Tab
requirements.description: Tab with list of active medications, including medication name, dosage, frequency, prescribing provider, refills remaining, and last filled date
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to view my active medications, so that I can manage my prescriptions

test_steps.expected_result: Tab displays with all required medication information

assumptions: Patient has valid profile information and prescription data

requirements.title: Billing Section
requirements.description: Section with patient statement, including service date, description, billed amount, insurance adjustment, insurance paid, and patient balance
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to view my billing information, so that I can manage my payments

test_steps.expected_result: Section displays with all required billing information

assumptions: Patient has valid profile information and billing data

requirements.title: Apointment Booking & Scheduling Page
requirements.description: Page for booking and scheduling appointments, including calendar view, appointment slots, and patient selection with filtering by availability
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want an appointment booking page, so that I can schedule appointments efficiently

requirements.title: Patient Management Portal Data Model
requirements.description: Data model including Patient, Provider, Appointment, ClinicalNote, Prescription, InsurancePlan, and LabResult entities with specified fields and relationships
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a scalable data model, so that we can support patient management securely
acceptance_criteria: All PHI fields are encrypted at rest using AES-256
Role-based authorization is enforced for PHI access

test_steps.test_data: Clinical note with encrypted PHI fields

assumptions: AWS KMS-managed keys are available for encryption

requirements.title: Patient Dashboard Data Model
requirements.description: Patient dashboard displays personalized greeting, upcoming appointments, and left sidebar navigation
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to view my personalized dashboard, so that I can see my upcoming appointments and access other features

requirements.title: Cloud-Native Deployment on Azure
requirements.description: Cloud-native deployment on Azure with HIPAA BAA compliance
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a HIPAA-compliant deployment, so that we can ensure patient data security

requirements.title: Database and Integration
requirements.description: Azure SQL with Transparent Data Encryption and geo-replication, and HL7 FHIR R4 for interoperability with EHR systems
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a secure and interoperable database and integration, so that we can ensure patient data security and sharing

requirements.title: Surescripts Integration for E-Prescriptions
requirements.description: Surescripts integration for e-prescriptions, with patient's preferred pharmacy notified
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a Surescripts integration for e-prescriptions, so that patients can have their prescriptions filled electronically
acceptance_criteria: E-prescription is sent to patient's preferred pharmacy

test_steps.action: Send e-prescription to patient's preferred pharmacy

assumptions: Surescripts API is available for integration

requirements.title: Insurance Claim and Billing Workflow
requirements.description: Insurance claim and billing workflow, with EDI 837 Professional claim submission and EDI 835 claim acknowledgment
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want an insurance claim and billing workflow, so that patients can have their insurance claims processed electronically
assumptions: EDI transaction is available for insurance claim submission

requirements.title: PHI Data Encryption
requirements.description: Encrypt all PHI fields using AES-256 with AWS KMS-managed keys
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to ensure PHI data is encrypted, so that I can protect patient information
acceptance_criteria: Encryption uses AES-256 with AWS KMS-managed keys

test_steps.expected_result: PHI fields are encrypted using AES-256 with AWS KMS-managed keys

requirements.title: Role-Based Authorization
requirements.description: Implement role-based authorization for PHI access
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to access PHI data based on my role, so that I can perform my duties
acceptance_criteria: Care team members can access PHI data based on their role

test_steps.expected_result: Role-based authorization is implemented and care team members can access PHI data based on their role

assumptions: Care team member roles are defined

requirements.title: REQ-HCP-075: PHI Access Logging
requirements.description: All PHI access events must be logged to an immutable audit table
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to track PHI access events, so that I can monitor and audit PHI access

test_steps.action: Verify PHI access events are logged
test_steps.expected_result: PHI access events are logged to an immutable audit table

requirements.title: PHI Data Protection Rules
requirements.description: REQ-HCP-073: All PHI fields must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 with AWS KMS-managed keys
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want to ensure PHI is protected, so that we can maintain patient trust
acceptance_criteria: All PHI fields are encrypted at rest using AES-256
assumptions: AWS KMS is available for key management

requirements.title: HIPAA Compliance
requirements.description: Annual HIPAA compliance audit must pass with zero high-risk findings
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure the system is HIPAA compliant, so that patient data is protected
acceptance_criteria: Annual audit passes with zero high-risk findings

test_steps.expected_result: Audit passes with zero high-risk findings

test_scenarios: Compliance test under various audit conditions

requirements.title: API Endpoint Security
requirements.description: All API endpoints must enforce HTTPS (TLS 1.2+)
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure API endpoints are secure, so that patient data is protected
test_scenarios: Security test under various API endpoint conditions

requirements.title: Role-Based Access Control
requirements.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) with 4 roles: Patient, Provider, Staff, Admin
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure access is controlled based on roles, so that patient data is protected
test_scenarios: Security test under various access conditions

requirements.title: Log Sanitization
requirements.description: PHI data must never appear in application logs
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure PHI data is not logged, so that patient data is protected
test_scenarios: Security test under various log conditions

requirements.title: Security Pattern for Patient Data
requirements.description: Encryption for patient data, with HIPAA-compliant security measures
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a security pattern for patient data, so that patient information is protected
assumptions: Encryption algorithm is available for patient data

requirements.title: Data Backup and Recovery
requirements.description: Implement data backup and recovery using Azure SQL point-in-time restore with 35-day retention and geo-replication to paired Azure region
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to ensure data is backed up and recoverable, so that I can access patient information in case of data loss
acceptance_criteria: Data backup and recovery is implemented
Data can be recovered within 4 hours

test_steps.action: Verify data backup and recovery is implemented
test_steps.expected_result: Data backup and recovery is implemented and data can be recovered within 4 hours

assumptions: Azure SQL point-in-time restore is available

requirements.title: REQ-HCP-079: Daily Full Backup
requirements.description: Daily full backup at 02:00 UTC with transaction log backups every 5 minutes
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to ensure data is backed up regularly, so that I can access patient information in case of data loss
acceptance_criteria: Transaction log backups are implemented every 5 minutes

test_steps.action: Verify daily full backup is implemented
test_steps.expected_result: Daily full backup is implemented and transaction log backups are implemented every 5 minutes

requirements.title: REQ-HCP-080: Annual Disaster Recovery Test
requirements.description: Annual disaster recovery test with full data restore validation
requirements.user_story: As a care team member, I want to ensure data can be recovered in case of a disaster, so that I can access patient information
acceptance_criteria: Annual disaster recovery test is implemented
Full data restore validation is implemented

test_steps.action: Verify annual disaster recovery test is implemented
test_steps.expected_result: Annual disaster recovery test is implemented and full data restore validation is implemented

assumptions: Disaster recovery test configuration is available

requirements.title: Video Consultation Connection Establishment Performance
requirements.description: Video consultation connection establishment < 3 seconds from click-to-first-frame
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to quickly establish a video consultation connection, so that I can communicate with my healthcare provider efficiently
test_scenarios: Performance test under various network conditions

requirements.title: Telehealth Service Scalability
requirements.description: Telehealth service must handle 200 simultaneous video sessions without quality degradation
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want the telehealth service to handle a large number of simultaneous video sessions, so that patients can access the service without quality issues

test_steps.expected_result: Telehealth service handles sessions without quality degradation

test_scenarios: Scalability test under various load conditions

requirements.title: Notification Service Scalability
requirements.description: Notification service must process 10,000 SMS/email per hour for appointment reminders
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want the notification service to handle a large volume of appointment reminders, so that patients receive timely reminders
acceptance_criteria: Notification service processes 10,000 reminders per hour

test_steps.expected_result: Notification service processes reminders without performance degradation

test_scenarios: Scalability test under various load conditions

requirements.title: Accessibility Compliance
requirements.description: Portal must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to access the portal using assistive technologies, so that I can use the portal efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Portal complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA

test_steps.expected_result: Portal complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA

test_scenarios: Accessibility test under various assistive technology conditions

requirements.title: System Uptime SLA
requirements.description: System uptime SLA: 99.95% (max 21.9 minutes downtime per month)
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure the system is available, so that patients can access the system
test_scenarios: Availability test under various system conditions

requirements.title: Telehealth Visit End-to-End Workflow
requirements.description: Patient logs in, navigates to scheduled telehealth appointment, clicks 'Join Video Visit'. Pre-consultation device check screen validates camera, microphone, and speaker. Browser permissions requested if not granted. Patient enters virtual waiting room. Queue position and estimated wait displayed.
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to attend a telehealth video consultation, so that I can remotely consult with a healthcare provider
ambiguities: What happens if patient is unable to join video visit?

requirements.title: HL7 FHIR R4 Compliance
requirements.description: HL7 FHIR R4 compliance validated using Touchstone test suite
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure the system is interoperable with other healthcare systems, so that patient data can be exchanged
acceptance_criteria: System is HL7 FHIR R4 compliant

test_steps.expected_result: System is HL7 FHIR R4 compliant

test_scenarios: Interoperability test under various healthcare system conditions

requirements.title: Surescripts Certification
requirements.description: Surescripts certification renewal annually
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure the system is certified by Surescripts, so that electronic prescriptions can be sent
test_scenarios: Interoperability test under various electronic prescription conditions

requirements.title: X12 EDI Transactions
requirements.description: X12 EDI transactions must comply with HIPAA 5010 standards
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure X12 EDI transactions are compliant with HIPAA 5010 standards, so that electronic transactions can be exchanged
acceptance_criteria: X12 EDI transactions comply with HIPAA 5010 standards

test_steps.expected_result: X12 EDI transactions comply with HIPAA 5010 standards

test_scenarios: Interoperability test under various electronic transaction conditions
